story.title: MobiKwik Secures NBFC Licence From RBI, Launches Own Lending Subsidiary to Move Beyond Distribution
story.summary: Digital payments and financial services platform MobiKwik has received a Non-Banking Financial Company licence from the Reserve Bank of India, allowing it to launch its own lending subsidiary, MobiKwik Financial Services Private Limited, and move from being a lending distributor to a direct lender. The NBFC licence is a significant regulatory milestone that gives MobiKwik control over its own credit products, pricing, and underwriting rather than acting as a pass-through for partner NBFCs. This transition is expected to improve unit economics and enable the platform to offer more competitive loan products to its user base of tens of millions of Indians.
